purposes.label: Research
purposes.description: Retrieves, ranks and packs evidence, then generates a cited Research response.
purposes.input_semantics: A research question and the chosen corpus and retrieval scope.
purposes.output_semantics: A generated research response with evidence-bound claims and citations.
purposes.authority_semantics: Retrieval and generation stay evidence-bound and provenance-aware. Relevance scores and model prose are not scholarly authority.

purposes.label: Reviewer evidence suggestion
purposes.description: Suggests source passages of the current Record that may support a metadata value under review.
purposes.input_semantics: A metadata field and value, and the current source scope.
purposes.authority_semantics: Relevance ranking alone never makes a candidate evidence. A suggestion becomes evidence only when a reviewer binds it.

purposes.label: Evidence recovery
purposes.description: Finds evidence for values that reached enrichment or acceptance without bound evidence, running costlier stages only when cheaper ones find nothing.
purposes.consumer: Corpus Builder → Metadata enrichment and value acceptance
purposes.input_semantics: A metadata value without bound evidence, and the current Record's source units.
purposes.output_semantics: Advisory recovered evidence candidates, without a confidence score.
purposes.authority_semantics: Recovered candidates are advisory and never count as reviewed evidence. Without the direct-support gate the output is not cELF-guaranteed.

purposes.label: Precedent evidence remapping
purposes.description: Finds where the current Record may support a value adopted from a reviewed precedent.
purposes.input_semantics: A reviewed precedent's evidence and the current Record's source units.
purposes.output_semantics: An advisory shortlist of the current Record's source units.
purposes.authority_semantics: The shortlist binds nothing and never carries the precedent's text or source identity.

purposes.label: Reviewer evidence choice
purposes.description: When a reviewer asks, a model chooses which of the Record's own source units support a metadata value.
purposes.consumer: Record review → Ask the model to choose evidence
purposes.input_semantics: A metadata value and the Record's current source-unit IDs.
purposes.output_semantics: Model-chosen source units, each checked deterministically.
purposes.authority_semantics: A suggestion stays advisory until the reviewer binds it.

purposes.label: Vector Store search
purposes.description: Searches a vector store collection for matching Records.
purposes.input_semantics: A search query and metadata filters.
purposes.authority_semantics: Search results do not establish evidence, validate a research claim or generate a research response.

purposes.label: Metadata precedents
purposes.description: Finds reviewed metadata precedents and corrections for the metadata-enrichment prompt.
purposes.input_semantics: The Record text and the metadata fields being enriched.
purposes.output_semantics: A bounded packet of advisory reviewed precedents.
purposes.authority_semantics: Precedents guide the model; they never decide a value. The metadata schema keeps field eligibility and thresholds.

purposes.label: Metadata pre-fill
purposes.description: Retrieves reviewed precedents that agree on a value so it can be offered as a pre-fill hint.
purposes.input_semantics: Source spans of the Record being built.
purposes.output_semantics: Advisory pre-fill hints from reviewed precedents.
purposes.authority_semantics: Whether a value is pre-filled is DerridAI's domain policy, not this pipeline's; reviewed or present values are never overwritten.

purposes.label: Metadata enrichment
purposes.description: Asks a chat model for one schema-derived metadata group at a time.
purposes.input_semantics: A Record and one metadata group from the active schema.
purposes.output_semantics: Proposed metadata values, validated at the backend.
purposes.authority_semantics: Model values are proposals. Reconciliation, evidence binding, field-assertion authority and autofill stay DerridAI's domain code.

purposes.label: Claim memory
purposes.description: Finds earlier reviewer-validated claims similar to the current research question.
purposes.input_semantics: A research question and its owner.
purposes.output_semantics: Similar validated claims, rejoined with their current support state.
purposes.authority_semantics: Memory is advisory. A pipeline changes how eligible claims are searched, never which claims are eligible.

purposes.label: Response memory
purposes.description: Finds earlier Research responses similar to the current research question.
purposes.input_semantics: A research question and its owner.
purposes.authority_semantics: Memory is advisory. A pipeline changes how eligible responses are searched, never which responses are eligible.

purposes.label: Document manifest
purposes.description: Asks a chat model once per analysis for a source-bound description of the document.
purposes.input_semantics: Embedded file metadata and a sample of the whole document.
purposes.output_semantics: A proposed bibliography, language and main-text page range.
purposes.authority_semantics: Embedded metadata, confident deterministic inferences and reviewer-confirmed structure outrank the model's answer.

purposes.label: Segmentation
purposes.description: Asks a chat model closed-choice questions about ambiguous or suspicious Record boundaries.
purposes.input_semantics: An ambiguous boundary or suspicious Record seam, with its source blocks.
purposes.output_semantics: A proposed boundary decision, checked deterministically.
purposes.authority_semantics: A failed, omitted or low-confidence answer keeps the boundary where it is.

purposes.label: Text touch-up
purposes.description: Asks a chat model to propose cleaned-up text for one Record.
purposes.consumer: Record review and metadata enrichment → Text touch-up
purposes.output_semantics: A proposed text revision, checked against the source text.
purposes.authority_semantics: A touch-up is only a proposal. Reviewed text changes only when a person approves it.

categories.label: Research
categories.description: Answers a research question with an evidence-bound, cited response.

categories.label: Evidence
categories.description: Suggests source passages that may support a metadata value. Suggestions stay advisory until a reviewer binds them.

categories.label: Search
categories.description: Finds matching Records. Search results are not evidence and make no research claim.

categories.label: Metadata
categories.description: Proposes metadata values or finds reviewed precedents for them.

categories.label: Memory
categories.description: Finds earlier Research claims or responses that may be relevant again.

categories.label: Corpus processing
categories.description: Prepares source text for review: document analysis, segmentation and text touch-up.

guarantees.label: Direct support
guarantees.description: A candidate must directly support the exact value or proposition before it is suggested.

guarantees.label: Source provenance
guarantees.description: Every result must bind to a real source unit of the current source document.

guarantees.label: Citation binding
guarantees.description: Citations come from Record metadata through deterministic code, never from the model.

guarantees.label: Reviewed precedents only
guarantees.description: Only reviewed values can serve as precedents; unreviewed model output never does.

guarantees.label: Eligible memory only
guarantees.description: Only reviewer-validated claims or responses that passed the grade gate can be recalled.

guarantees.label: Backend validation
guarantees.description: Every model answer is validated by DerridAI before it is used.

guarantees.label: Reviewer approval
guarantees.description: Results are proposals until a reviewer approves or binds them.

guarantees.label: Text conservation
guarantees.description: No source text may be lost, invented, duplicated or reordered.

guarantees.label: Access rules outside the pipeline
guarantees.description: Permissions, visibility and text limits are enforced by DerridAI, not by pipeline settings.

phases.label: Select / pack
phases.description: Keeps a bounded subset or packs context.

phases.label: Generate
phases.description: Asks a language model for output.

scholarly_effects.label: No scholarly effect
scholarly_effects.description: Passes data along or rescales scores. It establishes nothing about evidence or support.

scholarly_effects.label: Advisory only
scholarly_effects.description: Finds, orders or selects candidates by relevance. Relevance does not establish support, evidence or authority.

scholarly_effects.label: Scope constraint
scholarly_effects.description: Removes candidates outside the required schema, field, language or scope. It does not judge support.

scholarly_effects.label: Evidence eligibility gate
scholarly_effects.description: Lets a candidate through only when it directly supports the exact value. Passing is computational validation, not reviewer authority.

scholarly_effects.label: Provenance gate
scholarly_effects.description: Requires deterministic source identity and citation bindings. It checks where a result comes from, not whether it is true.

scholarly_effects.label: Transformation
scholarly_effects.description: Reshapes a query or packs context for a later step without judging it.

scholarly_effects.label: Model generation
scholarly_effects.description: Generates model output from the context it is given. The output is checked downstream and is never evidence by itself.

scholarly_effects.label: Evaluation
scholarly_effects.description: Assesses a finished result, for example by grading an answer against its evidence.

effect_notes.label: No scholarly effect
effect_notes.description: Establishes nothing about evidence or support.

effect_notes.label: Produces candidates — not evidence
effect_notes.description: Retrieval finds possible passages or Records. A retrieval score does not show that a passage supports anything.

effect_notes.label: Relevance ranking only — does not establish support
effect_notes.description: A higher score means more relevant to the query, not that the passage supports a claim.

effect_notes.label: Diversity selection — does not establish support
effect_notes.description: Balances relevance against variety. It does not show that any passage supports a claim.

effect_notes.label: Selection only — does not establish support
effect_notes.description: Keeps a bounded subset in the order it was given.

effect_notes.label: Scope constraint
effect_notes.description: Removes candidates outside the required scope. It does not judge support.

effect_notes.label: Evidence eligibility gate
effect_notes.description: Only candidates that directly support the exact value pass. A reviewer still decides what becomes evidence.

effect_notes.label: Provenance gate
effect_notes.description: Only results bound to real source units and citations pass.

effect_notes.label: Prepares input for a later step
effect_notes.description: Reshapes the query or packs context without judging it.

effect_notes.label: Generates model output from supplied context
effect_notes.description: The model's answer is validated downstream and is never evidence by itself.

effect_notes.label: Evaluates a finished result
effect_notes.description: Grades the output. A grade describes the run, not the truth of its claims.

cost_drivers.label: Storage reads
cost_drivers.description: Reads from the database or vector store.

cost_drivers.label: Embedding
cost_drivers.description: Embeds text with the embedding model.

cost_drivers.label: Model scoring
cost_drivers.description: Runs a local model over many items, such as a cross-encoder.

cost_drivers.label: Language-model generation
cost_drivers.description: Waits on a language model to read a prompt and write an answer.

complexity_variables.label: N
complexity_variables.description: Items in the collection or Record scope the stage searches.

complexity_variables.label: k
complexity_variables.description: Items the stage keeps or returns.

complexity_variables.label: L
complexity_variables.description: Text length of one item, in tokens.

complexity_variables.label: S
complexity_variables.description: Source units in the current Record.

complexity_orders.label: Constant
complexity_orders.description: Does not grow with input size.

complexity_orders.label: Sublinear
complexity_orders.description: Grows more slowly than the collection, for example an index lookup.

complexity_orders.label: Linear in candidates
complexity_orders.description: Grows in step with the candidates it receives.

complexity_orders.label: Sorting-like
complexity_orders.description: Grows a little faster than the candidates it receives, as sorting does.

complexity_orders.label: Scans the collection
complexity_orders.description: Reads the whole collection or Record scope, so it grows with corpus size.

complexity_orders.label: Superlinear in candidates
complexity_orders.description: Grows faster than the candidates it receives.

complexity_orders.label: One model pass per item
complexity_orders.description: Runs a model over every candidate.

complexity_orders.label: Generation
complexity_orders.description: Waits on a language model; time depends on prompt and answer length.

strategies.label: Metadata lexical fallback
strategies.description: When semantic metadata-precedent retrieval is unavailable, use bounded deterministic word-overlap ranking while preserving schema scope, reviewed analogy conditions, correction policy, and packet limits.

strategies.label: Metadata scope filter
strategies.description: Constrain precedent candidates by schema, stable field identities, language, scope, and reviewed analogy fields.

strategies.label: Metadata semantic/lexical fusion
strategies.description: Combine semantic and lexical precedent relevance while preserving field/kind provenance.

strategies.label: Reciprocal-rank fusion
strategies.description: Deduplicate logical candidates and fuse rankings from parallel retrieval branches using reciprocal-rank fusion.

strategies.label: Boundary classification
strategies.description: Ask a chat model a closed-choice question about a record boundary: split or keep an ambiguous transition, or whether a suspicious record seam should stay or move. Returned block IDs are checked deterministically; a failed, omitted, or low-confidence answer keeps the boundary. The stage chooses which configured provider answers and how many attempts it gets.

strategies.label: Closed-choice evidence selection
strategies.description: Ask a chat model to choose only among source-unit IDs from the current Record, then validate the IDs deterministically. Evidence recovery may scope the choice to a bounded upstream shortlist, falling back to the Record's source units when no shortlist exists. The stage also chooses which configured provider answers (by default the primary provider, then the review provider) and how many attempts each gets.

strategies.label: Document manifest
strategies.description: Ask a chat model once per analysis for a source-bound document manifest: bibliography, language and the main-text page range, from embedded file metadata and a sample of the whole document. Embedded metadata, a confident start-page inference and reviewer-confirmed structure still outrank the answer, and a failed call falls back to embedded metadata. The stage chooses which configured provider answers and how many attempts it gets.

strategies.label: Research answer generation
strategies.description: Generate the final evidence-grounded Research answer with the configured provider/model profile.

strategies.label: RAG response grading
strategies.description: Evaluate a generated answer against the evidence packet using the configured grading profile.

strategies.label: Reviewer evidence choice
strategies.description: When a reviewer asks, a chat model chooses which source-unit IDs of the Record support a metadata value. Every returned ID and its support are checked deterministically, and a suggestion stays advisory until the reviewer binds it. The stage chooses which configured provider answers and how many attempts it gets.

strategies.label: Structured metadata generation
strategies.description: Run one schema-derived structured metadata task and validate the returned object at the backend boundary. The active metadata schema supplies the task and answer shape; the stage chooses which configured provider answers and how many attempts it gets.

strategies.label: Text touch-up
strategies.description: Ask a chat model to propose cleaned-up text for one Record, on a reviewer request or during metadata enrichment when the build asks for it. The answer is checked against the source text and stays a proposal until a reviewer approves it. The stage chooses which configured provider answers and how many attempts it gets.

strategies.label: Metric-aware relevance normalization
strategies.description: Convert collection-native distance/raw-score semantics into a normalized relevance contract.

strategies.label: Evidence context packer
strategies.description: Build a citation-aware evidence packet under configured per-record and total context budgets.

strategies.label: Metadata precedent packet
strategies.description: Serialize selected reviewed precedents and corrections into the bounded metadata-enrichment prompt context.

strategies.label: Field-aware evidence query
strategies.description: Build an evidence query deterministically from the target metadata field and proposed value.

strategies.label: Query passthrough
strategies.description: Preserve the user query without invoking a model-based decomposition stage.

strategies.label: Research query decomposition
strategies.description: Use the configured chat model to derive bounded structured query metadata before retrieval.

strategies.label: Cross-encoder reranker
strategies.description: Score query/candidate text pairs with the shared sentence-transformers CrossEncoder boundary.

strategies.label: Lexical/vector fallback reranker
strategies.description: Use deterministic lexical overlap plus normalized vector relevance when the cross-encoder is unavailable.

strategies.label: Chroma semantic similarity
strategies.description: Embed the query and retrieve nearest candidates from a compatible Chroma collection.

strategies.label: Validated-claim memory
strategies.description: Retrieve owner-scoped semantically similar validated claims, then rejoin authoritative claim/support state.

strategies.label: Lexical BM25 retrieval
strategies.description: Rank candidate text with the local deterministic BM25-style lexical retriever.

strategies.label: Lexical memory fallback
strategies.description: When semantic memory retrieval fails, match eligible durable memory rows by word overlap without changing their authority or provenance status.

strategies.label: Metadata exemplar retrieval
strategies.description: Retrieve schema/field/language-filtered reviewed metadata precedents from the derived exemplar projection.

strategies.label: Prior-response memory
strategies.description: Retrieve owner-scoped semantically similar eligible Research responses and rejoin durable response state.

strategies.label: User-selected evidence
strategies.description: Resolve explicitly selected collection/record identifiers to authoritative Records without vector retrieval.

strategies.label: Source-unit semantic similarity
strategies.description: Compare a query embedding with source-unit embeddings inside the active source/Record scope.

strategies.label: Metadata filter
strategies.description: Return records matching the metadata filter without using the query text; contains filters match decoded list and text values.

strategies.label: Record text contains
strategies.description: Case-insensitive substring match on stored record text within the collection and metadata filter; an empty query lists records in storage order.

strategies.label: Word overlap
strategies.description: Deterministic Jaccard overlap between the query's words and each source unit's words, with no stopword removal; a unit with no shared word is never a candidate.

strategies.label: Reviewed-precedent hints
strategies.description: Rank reviewed-precedent values by how many earlier records agree, then mean and best similarity, and keep up to the limit whose best similarity reaches the threshold (never below the field's own schema threshold). Hints are advisory; whether a value is pre-filled is decided by DerridAI, not by this stage.

strategies.label: Metadata precedent quotas
strategies.description: Preserve field, match-tier, positive/correction, and configured precedent quotas.

strategies.label: Maximum marginal relevance
strategies.description: Select a relevance/diversity-balanced subset while preserving the underlying relevance and MMR objective as separate scores.

strategies.label: Source-aware diversity
strategies.description: Apply explicit work/document/Record/adjacency/overlap constraints after relevance reranking.

strategies.label: Top-K selection
strategies.description: Keep the highest-ranked K candidates without adding an additional relevance model.

strategies.label: Citation binding
strategies.description: Bind generated evidence markers to deterministic bibliographic citations and optional Works Cited entries.

strategies.label: Evidence support validator
strategies.description: Verify that a candidate span directly supports the exact proposition/value; implementation may be deterministic or model-assisted but emits a distinct support result.

strategies.label: Provenance sufficiency gate
strategies.description: Require source identity, revision/citation bindings, and other deterministic provenance needed by the consuming workflow.
